metadata.title: Public Frontend Reference Protocol Index
metadata.description: Reference protocol index separating pure machine extractions (MACHINE_OBSERVED) from human design annotations (ANNOTATION_TEMPLATE).

annotated_catalog.description: Human/design annotations explicitly excluded from forensic confirmation counts.

http_endpoints.role: Admin: assign device permissions to user
Authentication: check whether noAuth mode is active
Config: global default settings (bitrate, fps, etc.)
Device: list active and registered devices
Device: manage specific device by ID
Files: file management listing and deletion
Authentication: credentials login and session token issuance
Share: create temporary sharing link for device
Share: fetch metadata for shared device
Share: redeem card code for device access
Tags: manage device categories and label associations

websocket_client_messages.description: Sent by client immediately after WebSocket connection to target device session
Wraps signaling payloads (request-offer, answer, ice-candidate) forwarded to Agent
Direct shell/command execution request forwarded to agent via signaling server
WebSocket fallback for touch/clipboard when DataChannel is unavailable
Multi-device synchronized control broadcast across multiple phone sessions
Requests global system settings from signaling server

websocket_server_messages.description: Provides STUN/TURN ICE server configuration to connecting client
Delivers forwarded messages from Agent (offer, ice-candidate, clipboard, etc.)
Broadcasts that a device agent has connected and registered
Broadcasts that a device agent has disconnected
Initial synchronization of all online devices on WebSocket connect
Delivers asynchronous shell command execution output back to client
Signals token expiration, invalid permissions, or session kick

forward_payloads.description: Requests Agent to create a WebRTC PeerConnection, start scrcpy, and generate an SDP offer
Agent SDP offer containing video/audio media tracks and DataChannel attributes
Browser SDP answer with munged bandwidth parameters and audio preferences
Trickle ICE candidate exchange for P2P UDP/TCP hole punching
Fallback clipboard payload when clipboard-channel is not established

query_parameters.token: Session auth token (optional if share_token is used)

websocket_signaling.role: Agent registration and upstream command link

query_parameters.id: Agent / device unique identifier (passed via -id CLI flag)
